text.description_html:
Don-Jo 147 Store Door Aluminum Push and Pull Handle Set

The Store Door Push and Pull Handle Set comes packaged as a set including (1) exterior vertical pull bar with 33 inch center to centers, (1) interior horizontal push bar with 32 inch center to centers, and the mounting hardware for a1-3/4 inch thick aluminum door.

Specifications for the Don-Jo 1160147-AL Aluminum Storedoor Push and Pull Handle Set:

  • Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Satin Aluminum
  • Vertical Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Vertical Pull Center to Center (CTC): 33"
  • Interior Horizontal Push Bar Diameter: 1"
  • Interior Horizontal Push Bar Center to Center (CTC): 33"
  • Packaged with mounting hardware for an aluminum door.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"

*Sold as a Set (for 1 door). Made to order. NOT Returnable.
